# add osquery to toolset

Add [osquery](https://github.com/osquery/osquery), the SQL interface to operating-system state (processes, users, listening ports, installed apps), to the toolset — another instance of the author's interest in querying everything with SQL ([[DOT-96]]) and a useful inspection tool on a Mac.
